description: Memory-based collaborative filtering (user- vs item-based, cosine similarity), matrix factorization trained with SGD or ALS, implicit feedback, serving embeddings from Redis, and ANN search with HNSW and ScaNN - in system design interview terms.

hero.html:
Level 4 - Advanced 45 min HLD Recommendations

Recommendation Algorithms: Collaborative Filtering, Matrix Factorization and ANN

After this page you can explain, with numbers and a whiteboard sketch, how "people who bought this also bought" works, why matrix factorization replaced it for many products, how ALS trains on billions of clicks, how embeddings are served from Redis in milliseconds, and how HNSW and Google's ScaNN find the nearest vectors without scanning them all.
